integrity: Closed-form proof by binary carry and 2-adic valuations, with independently coded finite checks. Same-model review only. Independent scientific review is not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only constant-letter runs are classified, not arbitrary-period repetition runs or the full factor language. An existing general theorem bounds their lengths by 2^d; this work adds the full spectrum and exact per-length densities. The finite verifier is diagnostic, not a substitute for the infinite proof. Bibliographic coverage cannot rule out unindexed equivalent results.
title: Exact constant-run spectra and densities in binary all-one-pattern parity words
